verdict.rationale: Yapily's own Data API documents balance retrieval for consented accounts, and its Get Accounts endpoint 'Returns all accounts and balances', so a developer can fetch balances programmatically. The evidence never describes the balance as real-time, never shows a dedicated balance endpoint, and never positions balance as a pre-payment NSF or risk check. missing for 10: dedicated balance endpoint documentation, real-time freshness guarantees, documented NSF/risk-check use case tied to payment initiation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can fetch a real-time balance for a connected account before initiating a payment — a documented balance endpoint intended for NSF and risk checks

citations.quote: Returns all accounts and balances for the end user associated with the presented consent token.
Retrieve accounts, balances, and transactions with user consent.
Using Yapily's Data API you can access your customers' financial data including account balances, transaction history and account details
